title: Asahina Mafuyu — Finding A Way To Repay〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

No, thank you as well!
We really appreciate you deciding to visit our shop today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: My break is about to end, so you'll have to excuse me here. Please come and visit us again whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Thank you.
You're also welcome at our place anytime.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Thank you! Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: S-Sis?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki?! Wait, you're all here...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Talk about a surprise. I wasn't expecting to see you here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Me neither.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Sorry, Mizuki...
I know I promised you that we'd visit this shop together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: A clerk from this shop came to visit our pop-up store, so I came by to say hello too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't worry, I also kinda jumped the gun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're really sorry. We're looking for something and Mizuki said that this shop might have it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Don't worry, it's all good with me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Ah, my break's about to end!
I need to hurry back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Have fun shopping, Mizuki, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, good luck with work!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your sister was here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That really made me jump.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: To be fair, her pop-up store's just over there, so there was always a chance of this happening.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
True...
Anyway, shall we start looking for a scarf to buy her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope they have just the right one.
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I couldn't help but overhear your conversation just now. Are you friends of Ms. Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, yes. We owe her quite a lot, so we're hoping to find a scarf here to give her as a gift.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: A scarf...

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: Then, I can show you what Ms. Akiyama was looking at just now. Here we are...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, the pattern on this scarf's gorgeous!
This has more presence than most regular clothes out there...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, putting together an outfit that includes this isn't gonna be easy.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: But I'm sure that Ms. Akiyama would be able to pull it off just fine.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: When I spoke to her just now, she seemed very interested in it. So, I'm sure she'd love it if you got it for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really...?! Oh, is this the only color it comes in?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
It comes in a few different colors.
I'll bring them over if you'll bear with me for a second.
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We seem to have finally found the perfect scarf for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But is this really okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I don't see any problems.
Especially since we just heard that Yuki showed clear interest in it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
Are you worried that she was just being polite?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't know if we're thinking the same thing, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I also sorta don't feel completely okay with this either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We're basically cheating, you know?
Like a drawing where you're guaranteed to win the grand prize.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Ah, it's like, are we really showing all the gratitude we ought to!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, she would certainly be happy if we got her that scarf...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we can't really say that we chose it for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What do you think, Mafuyu?
Is that more or less what you were trying to say?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think so...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We ended up buying her an assortment of Japanese snacks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But Sis and the shop staff were so happy when we presented our gift to them!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We spent a lot of time thinking about what to get her, but I'm glad that we managed to find something good in the end.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. And we got to thank her again for those scrunchies.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry. After you told us about that shop...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wrong! You're not supposed to apologize there, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We ended up taking the scenic route, but we were ultimately able to find a gift that made her smile!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, what do you say when something good and happy happens, again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You're very welcome♪
